ref_entities: run the InferencePipeline on an input image to generate a 3D mesh and GLB output
build an InferencePipeline instance with config paths and checkpoint paths for all sparse structure and SLAT models
run sample_sparse_structure to generate 3D sparse structure coordinates from a preprocessed image dictionary
run sample_slat to generate structured latent features conditioned on image input and sparse structure coordinates
run decode_slat to convert a sparse latent tensor into mesh and gaussian splat formats
run the InferencePipelinePointMap pipeline to generate 3D objects from an image with optional pointmap input
run compute_pointmap to extract a pointmap tensor and intrinsics from an input image using the depth model
run post-optimization on a mesh GLB to refine rotation, translation, and scale using layout and pointmap data
run Gaussian Splatting post-optimization to refine pose parameters using rendering optimization and occlusion checks
run plane estimation from a pointmap dict and image to extract a ground plane mesh using Open3D
run layout_post_optimization to refine mesh pose using ICP and render-and-compare against a mask
run layout_post_optimization_method_GS to refine Gaussian Splatting pose using ICP and RGB mask supervision
get a pose decoder by name from POSE_DECODERS to decode model output into translation rotation and scale
downsample sparse structure coordinates by rescaling the grid when exceeding a maximum coordinate count
estimate the bounding box area of a mask as a fraction of the total image area
check if a 2D mask is occluded by analyzing depth edges, border proximity, and internal holes using a 3D point map
align a 3D mesh to a target point cloud by scaling, translating, and computing initial IoU against a rendered mask
optimize a mesh pose by iteratively adjusting quaternion rotation, translation, and scale to minimize rendered mask loss against a ground truth mask
optimize a Gaussian Splatting object pose using combined RGB and mask supervision to minimize rendering loss against ground truth images
compute the intersection over union between a rendered mask and a ground truth mask with configurable thresholding
get a PreProcessor configured with image and mask transforms for SAM 3D object preprocessing
build a preprocessing pipeline that pads images to square, resizes to 518, and applies background removal
create an image transform that pads to square centered and resizes with bicubic interpolation to 518
create a mask transform that pads to square centered and resizes with nearest neighbor interpolation to 518
review the default preprocessor configuration including joint transforms for cropping around masks and removing backgrounds
